name: Lisra.Ai
author: lisraai

sections.description:
Most chat plugins give you a box that collects messages. Lisra.Ai gives your website a working support agent — one that understands any language, speaks as well as it types, knows your actual products, and knows when to step aside for a human.

It is the same agent your whole business runs on: every conversation, contact and order lands in your Lisra Ai Agent workspace, where your team sees it, continues it, and measures it.

💬 Type or speak — in every language, automatically

Your visitors write in whatever language they think in — English, Spanish, Bangla, Arabic, anything. The agent detects the language on its own and replies in the same one, fluently. No language list to configure, no translation plugin, nothing to set up. A store in Florida can serve a customer from Madrid at 3 a.m., in Spanish, without anyone waking up.

🎤 Real voice conversations — one assistant, two ways in

This is where Lisra stands apart. A microphone button sits right next to the send button. A visitor who cannot type — or simply prefers talking — taps it, speaks in their own language, and the agent answers out loud in a natural human voice, and in text at the same time. Spoken language is detected automatically, just like typed. Voice and text are one conversation with one memory: a visitor can speak one message, type the next, and the agent follows perfectly.

🛍️ Answers from your REAL products, with direct links

With WooCommerce store sync on, the agent answers product questions from your actual catalog — real titles, real prices, real stock. When a customer shows interest, the agent confirms exactly which product they mean and hands them a direct link to that product’s page on your store. It never invents a price, a discount or a product. If it does not know, it says so — and brings in your team.

🎨 Your brand, not ours

The widget dresses itself in your website’s own colour the moment it loads, and shows your logo in its header. Prefer full control? Pick an exact colour, a round or square launcher, and the chat text size from your Lisra dashboard. Your customers see your brand, end to end.

🤝 A human is always one step away

The agent is honest about its limits. When a question needs a person — a complaint, a special request, anything it is unsure of — it flags the conversation and your team takes over from Lisra’s Conversation Lab. The visitor sees the human reply in the same chat window, in their own language, clearly labeled as the team.

📈 Every visitor becomes intelligence

Conversations land in your Lisra CRM automatically: contacts are created, serious buyers are distinguished from casual browsers by evidence-based lead scoring, and your team sees the full history behind every name. The chat on your website stops being a message box and becomes the front door of your pipeline.

⚡ Light on your site

One small script tag, loaded asynchronously after your content. Your pages never wait for it. No iframes of other people’s branding, no cookies for tracking, no third-party ad networks.

You need a Lisra Ai Agent account

This plugin is the bridge between your website and your Lisra Ai Agent workspace — the workspace is where your agent’s knowledge, conversations, CRM, voice settings and team live. The plugin cannot operate without it.

Create your account (or sign in) at: https://app.lisra.ai — then copy your keys from the dashboard into this plugin’s settings page. Setup takes minutes.

To learn more about the Lisra Ai Agent platform, visit https://lisraai.com.

Honest by design

This plugin is a genuine interface to the Lisra.Ai service (https://app.lisra.ai). The chat widget is a small script loaded from Lisra’s servers; store sync sends this site’s own catalog and orders to Lisra’s signed API, authenticated with keys only you hold. Conversations and synced data are stored in your own Lisra workspace. No data is sold or shared with third parties.
sections.installation:
1. Create your Lisra Ai Agent account first — sign up (or sign in) at https://app.lisra.ai and complete the short setup. The workspace IS your agent; the plugin cannot work without it.
  2. Install the plugin: search “Lisra.Ai” in Plugins → Add New (or upload the ZIP), then Activate.
  3. In Lisra, open Agent → “Install on your website” and press Enable the website widget — copy the Widget key.
  4. In WordPress, go to Settings → Lisra.Ai, paste the Widget key, tick Enable widget, Save. The chat button — with its microphone — is now on every page.
  5. (WooCommerce only) In Lisra, open Website Integrations → WooCommerce and press Generate store keys — copy the Connection key and the Signing secret (the secret is shown once). Paste both into Settings → Lisra.Ai → Store sync, tick the sync box, Save, then press Sync all products now once.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Lisra account?

Yes — the plugin connects your site to your Lisra Ai Agent workspace, where the agent’s knowledge, conversations and settings live. Create one at https://app.lisra.ai.

How many products can I sync?

Free covers 50 products, Launch 2,000, Growth 10,000, and Professional and above have no limit. Anything beyond your plan is NOT synced — it is refused rather than stored where the assistant cannot see it, because an assistant holding products it may not mention would tell your customers you do not sell them. If that happens the plugin shows a large alert with the numbers and a link to upgrade.

Does Lisra charge by product count?

No. Plans are metered in AI credits — conversations. Catalogue size barely changes cost at all, because the assistant searches your catalogue for each question rather than loading all of it into every answer. The product ceiling on Free exists so a trial stays a trial.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes. The chat widget works on any WordPress site. Store sync is the only part that needs WooCommerce, and its section explains that on the settings screen.

Which languages does it support?

Any language the visitor uses — typed or spoken. The agent detects the language automatically and replies in it. Your team can reply in their own language; the visitor sees it translated.

How does the voice button work?

The visitor taps the microphone, speaks, and the same agent answers in text and out loud. In browsers that cannot record, the button simply does not appear and chat works as usual.

Will it slow my site down?

No. The widget is one small script tag loaded asynchronously after your page — your content never waits for it.

What happens when the AI cannot answer?

It says so honestly and flags the conversation for a human. Your team answers from Lisra, and the visitor sees the reply in the same chat, in their language.

Where is my data stored?

In your own Lisra workspace. The plugin sends only what the features need: chat messages, and — if you enable store sync — your catalog and orders, signed with your own secret.
sections.changelog:
1.0.8

  • If your shop has more products than your Lisra plan covers, the sync now says so loudly — how many did not fit, what it means for your assistant, and where to upgrade — instead of reporting a clean success.

1.0.7

  • Corrected where the store keys come from: Website Integrations → WooCommerce → “Generate store keys”. The settings screen and the install steps used to point at the connector for custom-built sites, which was the wrong page.

1.0.6

  • Wording throughout now says what the product actually is — an assistant that handles typed chat, voice conversations and product links — rather than “chat widget”, which described only part of it.

1.0.5

  • The plugin now carries the correct brand name, Lisra.Ai. Written as “Lisra AI” the capital I is indistinguishable from a lowercase L in most fonts, so it could be misread as “Lisra Al”.

1.0.4

  • Ships the header fix that missed the 1.0.3 package: other plugins’ admin notices now sit below the Lisra header instead of inside it.

1.0.3

  • New Appearance panel, right in WordPress: set the widget’s brand colour, round or square launcher, bottom-left or bottom-right position, and chat text size — with a live preview that shows exactly what your visitors will see.
  • Leave it untouched and the widget keeps reading your site’s own colour automatically.
  • The microphone now explains itself: if a browser blocks it, the widget says how to unblock it instead of just reporting failure.

1.0.2

  • Store sync now sends each product’s own page link, so the Lisra chat agent can hand customers the exact product they ask about — as a real link to your store, never an invented one.

1.0.1

  • Redesigned settings screen with honest status pills, and warnings when sync is on without keys or a key looks wrong.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: chat widget injection + WooCommerce catalog/order sync via Lisra’s signed ingest API.
